items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Simeon? The clarinet player. Yeah, I remember when he got, I don't know, he died, didn't he?

ctx.x: No. Simeon was young when he went out there.
Simeon? The clarinet player. Yeah, I remember when he got, I don't know, he died, didn't he? Mm-hmm. Yeah.
Yeah. Yeah. He played with the Red Hines all the time.
Well they had a band that played there, but I don't know who they were, they wouldn't be there on Sundays.

Yeah, Wilbur the Paris is working out now. Is he? Yeah, you know Simeon died, huh? How long ago? Oh it's just been a, he went in the hospital on Labor Day and he just died about a week ago. Well I didn't know that, see that? Maybe ten days, almost Simeon died. I didn't know that.
See all that hits me man, just, when I hear things like that, this boots me off.
